final_rationale: The Actor response improves the framing but does not add new admissible evidence. It correctly concedes that the current record does not support caveat-free certification and that public guidance cannot substitute for the internal policy predicates. That narrowing matters analytically, but it is a reinterpretation of the same evidence, not new proof that the required disclosure is actually present or that policy conditions have been satisfied in the operative artifacts. On the current record, a caveated path to compliance may exist, but present compliance is not established from admissible evidence alone. The unresolved limitation, incomplete mitigation artifact, and lack of independent verification of the actual disclosure text keep the audit outcome at suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was provided; the Actor only narrowed the characterization of the same record.
The record still contains an unresolved material weakness in the property-insurance underwriting slice.
The mitigation runbook remains draft-state and, on the available summary, does not satisfy the policy predicate for an approved mitigation.
There is still no independently verified model-card or equivalent artifact showing the limitation is expressly disclosed and not contradicted by broader 'no known material limitations' language.
Evidence access is limited to the Actor's summary, so readiness measurements, rehearsal records, approval state, and disclosure text remain unverified.
